name: Frankfurt Cube Days 2018

venue.name: Gemeindehaus Thomasgemeinde
venue.address: Heddernheimer Kirchstraße 5, 60439 Frankfurt am Main, Germany

information: The entrance fee is 5 Euro per competitor and day (= 10 Euro for both days) and has to be payed at the venue on the first day that you registered for. If you are not able to come, please let us know until January 31st, which is also the last opportunity to cancel your registration at no costs. If you don't show up without canceling, you will be charged the full entrance fee. Entrance fee for guests is 5 Euro (ticket will be valid on both days). Please have a look at the competition website for more details.
